opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants – Research Awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications not considered. Early career researchers welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture studies, history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry into the human past. Includes named awards (Marion Wilson, Joan Pye, Hugh Chapman).

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references required.
opportunities.summary: Research grants in commemoration of Beatrice de Cardi, supporting research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, particularly archaeological research.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Fund supporting research into dress and textiles, in commemoration of Janet Arnold.

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.summary: Travel awards supporting research travel in archaeology and the study of the material past, in memory of Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Travel awards for applicants who require funds primarily for their own research travel.
opportunities.summary: Travel awards supporting research travel for research into the material past, in memory of William Lambarde.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Requires supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church interiors, monuments and related church heritage. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications submitted via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research, applied for through the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants process.
